products.name: Sonim XP Pro
products.summary: Ultra-rugged 5G work phone with IP68/IPX9K, MIL-STD-810H and Class I Div 2 certification, a 6.58-inch Gorilla Glass Victus 2 display and 100 dB+ speakers.
products.description: Sonim XP Pro is a rugged 5G smartphone for field and frontline teams, sold through US carriers including AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon.
